title: Reel · Ferritin — exhausted but 'labs normal'
caption:
Exhausted, but your labs came back 'normal'? Ferritin — the iron-storage test — isn't in a routine CBC. Iron cut fatigue ~48% in nonanemic low-ferritin women (CMAJ 2012). Send this to her — what did yours say?
www.aiforheratx.org
#womenshealth #ferritin #irondeficiency #fatigue #anemiaawareness
